seoTitle: Is a PhD Funded for International Students? How to Check the Advert
title: Is a PhD Funded for International Students? How to Check the Advert
content:
A 'fully funded' headline is not enough to establish what an international applicant would receive. Check fee status, living support, award duration and whether the international tuition difference is covered.

Read the fee coverage carefully

Look for explicit wording about overseas tuition fees, international fee waivers or restrictions to Home-fee applicants. A studentship paying the Home rate may leave a substantial gap for an international student. Ask the funding office whether that difference is covered for your circumstances.

Check living support and duration

Identify the stipend or salary, payment frequency and guaranteed funding period. Separate an advertised current rate from a future rate that has not been announced. Ask about insurance, research expenses and whether the award continues during extensions, fieldwork or approved leave.

Get confirmation before accepting

Ask: Does this award cover my assessed tuition fee in full, and what living support is guaranteed for each funded year? Keep the written answer with the offer. Eligibility to apply, admission and selection for funding are separate decisions, so confirm the package attached to your actual offer.

Use a fee-gap question that gets a precise answer

Ask the funding office: “If I am assessed as an international student, will this award cover my full tuition fee or only the Home rate?” Then ask about stipend duration and costs outside the award. Keep the answer with the offer documents. A listing can be fully funded for one fee category and only partially funded for another. Do not infer a waiver from the words “international applicants welcome.” Those words establish who can apply, not necessarily who receives full overseas-fee coverage.

Relevant listings and guides on NextApply

To see how these questions apply to a real listing, review Eco-Friendly and High Performing Organic Photovoltaics at University of Edinburgh. Compare its stated requirements with your own preparation and check the official source before applying.

You can also browse The University of Edinburgh on NextApply and the PhD positions category. Listings and recruitment windows can change.

For the next part of your preparation, read What Is a Self-Funded PhD? Costs, Risks and Funding Alternatives, How to Read a PhD Job Advert: Funding, Eligibility and Application Steps.
